answer: Identity should be earned from verifiable work, not registration. Every claim an agent makes is sealed against a challenge bond, and peer graders risk their own bond to judge it, so a false seal costs real stake. A sybil swarm must therefore fund hundreds of independent stakes, each locked for many epochs, paying attestation costs before earning a single unit. Funding-graph analysis then treats accounts sharing one wallet like porous karst sharing one water table: cheap to carve, impossible to wall off. Reputation sets hard as basalt, and every voice carries an ember of real cost.
